operations.name: Cut bar stock to length
operations.description: Cut Ø45 C45 round bar to 184 mm (180 mm overall length + 4 mm facing allowance).

operations.name: CNC turning - side A
operations.description: Clamp on raw bar. Face side A, centre drill, rough and finish turn Ø40, turn Ø25h6 x 40 mm leaving 0.2 mm grinding allowance, chamfer 1x45°.
operations.tools: CNMG 120408 roughing insert, VBMT 160404 finishing insert, centre drill A3.15

operations.name: CNC turning - side B
operations.description: Re-clamp on Ø40 with soft jaws. Face to overall length 180 ±0.1, centre drill, turn Ø30k6 x 40 mm leaving 0.2 mm grinding allowance, chamfer 1x45°.
operations.tools: VBMT 160404 finishing insert, centre drill A3.15, soft jaws Ø40

operations.name: CNC milling - keyway
operations.description: Clamp in a V-block fixture on Ø40. Mill keyway 8P9 x 28 mm, depth t=4 mm, on the Ø30k6 section, 6 mm from the shoulder.
operations.tools: Ø8 carbide keyway end mill, V-block fixture

operations.name: Grinding - bearing seats
operations.description: Between centres: grind Ø25h6 and Ø30k6 bearing seats to size, Ra 1.6.

operations.name: Deburring
operations.description: Remove burrs from the keyway edges and chamfers, break sharp edges 0.3 max, clean the part.

operations.name: Final inspection
operations.description: Check Ø25h6, Ø30k6, keyway width 8P9 and depth, overall length 180 ±0.1, Ra 1.6 on bearing seats. First piece 100%, then sampling 1/10. Record results in the inspection report.
operations.tools: Micrometers 0-25 / 25-50 mm, keyway gauge 8P9, roughness tester

general_notes: [MOCK RESPONSE] Stepped shaft Ø25h6 / Ø40 / Ø30k6, overall length 180 mm, material C45 according to the title block. Assumed stock: round bar Ø45. Bearing seats h6/k6 with Ra 1.6 are finished on the shaft grinder 0302 (0.2 mm allowance left in turning) - if fine turning is sufficient for the customer, operation 5 can be removed. Both turning set-ups are on the same CNC lathe 0502 to keep one programme owner. Keyway milled on the small CNC mill 0402. There is no washing station in the machine list; cleaning is included in deburring. Keyway depth read as t=4 mm - please verify. Heat treatment is not specified on the drawing. Times estimated for a batch of 50 pcs.
